preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 20,000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 2 and 100,000.
The maximum possible sum of weights S must be between 1 and 10^16.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n and 1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= w_i <= 10**6 and c_i in {1, 2} for v_i, u_i, w_i, c_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid vertices, have a weight between 1 and 1,000,000, and a cost of either 1 or 2.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum total cost required to make the sum of weights of paths from the root to each leaf at most S.
